body.x: Ballistic, unveils Aspira, its latest collection of ultra-thin, protective cases at CES2013.

Aspira’s sleek profile creates minimal bulk and delivers maximum protection for your mobile phone. It offers repeated drop protection by combining a soft rubber interior and corner bumpers with a hard plastic exterior. Aspira also sports a high polish finish in a range of patterns and colors, offering the best in style as well as protection.
The Ballistic Aspira series will be unveiled for the first time ever at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas on January 8, 2013 – Booth #6411 North Hall.

Aspira series cases include an attractive, one piece shell that moves unabated in and out of your pocket. Reinforced corners allow it to survive drops. The lay on the table feature provides extra support to keep your screen safe. Designed with dual layer protection, Aspira series cases defend your phone against whatever violent shock or heavy impact it encounters.

“They’re sleek. They’re trendy. They’re strong enough to handle daily life,” says Adam Stubin, VP of Business Development at Ballistic. “Why sacrifice looks for protection? The new Aspira series offers the protection you desire in a style that will take your breath away.”
